name: Learn & Earn
org: NYC Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD)
what_you_do: This program helps high school juniors and seniors explore careers. You get academic support and college application help. You learn to be ready for work. You do service learning and leadership. There is a paid six-week summer internship.
who_can_apply: NYC high school juniors and seniors who live in New York City, are low income (or meet an exception such as public assistance, foster care or living in a high-poverty area) and meet at least one other listed need. The page lists age 16 to 21 in one place and 14 to 21 in another, so ask a provider.
pay_detail: Paid six-week summer internship. Rate not stated on the page.
duration: Year-round program with a six-week paid summer internship
deadline_text: Page says enrollment dates are September 1 to 30 (year not stated). That window has passed for this fall.
how_to_apply: Contact a Learn & Earn provider from the DYCD list, or call DYCD Community Connect at 1-800-246-4646. Providers check your eligibility.
notes: Income-based, with extra eligibility rules listed on the page. Teens under 18 need NYS working papers (NYS Department of Labor). See permit.html?state=ny for the exact permit and steps.
